notes:
## New features
- Calculate over the sheet area or the whole view. A new button beside the view lock limits Calculate to the dashed sheet area (the default) or extends it across the full editor view. The solve summary and staleness checks follow the choice.
- Automatic isoline label size. Labels now default to "Auto", which keeps them small but readable in proportion to the map, including on the sheet. A fixed size can still be chosen.

## Changes
- The contour sheet header is rebuilt as two compact rows: the sheet selector with New, sheet actions and auto-hide, and one Run dropdown listing every saved run (newest first, stale runs marked).
- Contour colour presentation: Bands/Gradient is full width again, with the palette and its actions on the row below.
- The Result, Contours and Map pages no longer repeat the page name as a title or indent their contents; all four pages line up.
- The Fullscreen button was removed from the contour preview toolbar.
- Button outlines set by individual panels (for example the sheet overlay toggles) are removed too.
- Exporting results no longer interrupts with a "trusted subset" prompt. The workbook's Readiness sheet records scope and any open items. Reflections and line, area and transport sources are validated and are now reported as scope notes, not blockers.
- Stacked receptors share their base ID with the floor in brackets, for example "REC_001 (GF)" and "REC_001 (1)", in the Results table and exports. Exports add a Model ID column with each receptor's stored ID.
- The validation certificate names ISO 9613-2:2024 and ISO 9613-2:1996 in full, adds a headline summary, shows the share of the ±0.5 dB tolerance each ISO/TR 17534-3 case uses, and cites why the test cases exist.

## Bug fixes
- Isoline labels now appear on every isoline, including long smooth rings. Labels are placed on the drawn Bézier curve, not on its sparse anchor points.
- SmartSmooth no longer loses smoothing on whole isolines when one small edge conflicts; only the conflicting edges fall back, so changing colour presets keeps the lines smooth.
- Opening the Contours tab could fail with "Internal C++ object (QThread) already deleted". Background contour workers now keep their own thread reference.
